cause_quote: The introducing diff registered `system.info` with `scope: "operator.read"` and returned `diskPath: stateDir` whenever disk capacity was available, without checking for admin scope.
user_saw: Read-only Gateway callers could see the host’s state-directory path and, after mounted-disk reporting was added, could also see mount paths.
summary: The fix restricts disk paths and mounted-disk discovery in `system.info` to admins while preserving state-volume capacity totals for read-only callers.
reasoning: The parent of the introducing commit already restricted `stateDir` in the connection snapshot to admin callers. PR #100478 exposed the same path to read-only callers from the first version of `system.info`. PR #136079 later expanded the exposure by adding mount paths to the response.
